experiment_1_hereditary_obstruction_exis.theorem_checked: For a downward-closed compatibility family, existence of an incompatible configuration is upward-closed in size whenever extensions of that size exist.

target_interfaces.mealy_note: A nerve is downward-closed under subsets; therefore non-face existence is upward-closed up to the number of available vertices. Minimal-nonface size spectrum is a different invariant and is not claimed monotone.

experiment_2_finite_summary_too_weak.conclusion: Finite-summary/automaton representation alone permits both gapped spectra and upper-tail spectra, so it cannot transfer the Mealy/V19 hereditary monotonicity or their numerical obstruction bounds to Delta_h.

verdict.scope: Refutes only an interface identifying Delta_h nonemptiness at horizon h with existence of an incompatible configuration of cardinality h in a hereditary set/multiset compatibility system, preserving extension and exact index.
verdict.does_not_refute: Mappings to minimal-obstruction spectra, enriched witness automata, non-index-preserving transforms, or other abstractions.
verdict.next_route: Separate Delta_h from the hereditary compatibility branch; continue Mealy<->V19 via order ideals/minimal forbidden configurations if a non-tautological transferred bound can be found.
